trace.question: Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.
trace.evidence: single-bonded molecules refers to bond_type = '-' ; average number of oxygen atom = AVG(element = 'o')

attempts.sql:
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
)

trace.final_sql:
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
)
trace.answer: The average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules is about 0.081.
